title: The Vanishing at Flannan Isles
hook: In December 1900, three lighthouse keepers vanished from a remote Scottish island, leaving behind a frozen clock, an untouched meal, and a diary detailing a storm that never existed.

scenes.narration: Twenty miles off the coast of Scotland lies Eilean Mòr, a desolate rock shrouded in heavy mist. For over a century, sailors have spoken in hushed tones about the night the light went out.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic moody wide shot of a jagged rocky island in the Atlantic Ocean surrounded by dense grey fog, with an isolated white lighthouse towering against dark waves.

scenes.narration: When a relief vessel finally reached the island after days of delay, the shore was dead silent. The entrance gates were bolted shut, and no flag flew to greet them.
scenes.visual_prompt: Slow tracking shot approaching rusted iron gates on a wind-swept cliffside, wet rocks slick with sea spray under a gloomy twilight sky.

scenes.narration: Stepping inside the lighthouse, searchers uncovered a chilling freeze-frame: a table set with an untouched meal, a clock stopped dead, and two missing oilskin coats.
scenes.visual_prompt: Atmospheric interior shot of a 1900s stone kitchen, showing a rusty clock frozen at 8:30, cold cast-iron cookware, and an empty coat peg.

scenes.narration: The final diary entry noted a terrifying, monstrous storm that reduced seasoned men to tears. Yet weather records from the mainland proved the skies were completely calm.
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of handwritten ink entries in a weathered leather logbook, softly illuminated by flickering candlelight while shadows stretch across stone walls.

scenes.narration: Three men vanished without a trace, swallowed by the island's isolation. Over a century later, the sea still keeps the terrifying secret of Flannan Isles.
scenes.visual_prompt: High-altitude pull-away shot revealing the tiny desolate island shrinking into the vast, ink-black sea under a cloud-choked sky.
